title: O-band bismuth-doped phosphosilicate fiber amplifier of Firstov et al. (2020): reference data (not a model card)
model: none. No amplifier model of this review uses these entries. The block 'consistency_tests' records why: a single-center two-level (Giles-type) reading of the fitted saturation data is not consistent with the measured amplifier data (checked by tables_bands.py)

device.type: Bi-doped single-mode fiber with F-doped depressed cladding (MCVD)
device.transition: bismuth active centers (BACs) associated with phosphorus; structure of the centers not established; pumped in band at 1230 nm

reference_plane: as reported by the source (gain and NF measured with an optical spectrum analyzer at the amplifier ports); splice loss 0.15 dB stated; losses of isolators and WDM couplers are not stated in the text
source_full: S. V. Firstov, A. M. Khegai, A. V. Kharakhordin, S. V. Alyshev, E. G. Firstova, Y. J. Ososkov, M. A. Melkumov, L. D. Iskhakova, E. B. Evlampieva, A. S. Lobanov, M. V. Yashkov, A. N. Guryanov, Compact and efficient O-band bismuth-doped phosphosilicate fiber amplifier for fiber-optic communications, Sci. Rep. 10, 11347 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41598-020-68243-4. Open access (CC BY 4.0); full text read via PubMed Central PMC7347876 on 17 Nov 2026; author list and article number confirmed in the Crossref record.
notes: Category conventions for a reference card: 'measured' = reported by the source for this fiber or amplifier; 'fitted' = parameter obtained by the source by fitting its Eq. (1) to its own transmission-saturation measurements; 'derived' = computed by the source (mode radius, overlap) or here (ratios), as stated; 'config' = operating condition of the source's experiment. Level V1 = value, unit and applicability confirmed against the open-access full text. alpha0 is the saturable part of the small-signal absorption (alpha0 = 4.34 N0 sigma_a Gamma in the source); alpha_BG is added separately as unsaturable (background) loss.

source.locator: 'around 0.0115' between core and first F-doped (depressed) cladding

depressed_ratio.applies_to: ratio of depressed-cladding radius to core radius

Bi_content.applies_to: total bismuth content (estimate by the source); the BAC density is stated to be one to two orders of magnitude lower and is not quantified

omega_1230.derivation: computed by the source (Table 1) from the fiber design; not recomputed here
omega_1230.applies_to: mode power radius at the pump wavelength

omega_1310.derivation: computed by the source (Table 1); not recomputed here
omega_1310.applies_to: mode power radius at the signal wavelength

Gamma_1230.derivation: power-independent overlap integral of doping profile and mode envelope, computed by the source (Table 1)

alpha0_1230.fit: Eq. (1) of the source fitted to the transmission of a 50 m sample versus launched power at 1230 nm (Fig. 2); the small-signal absorption at 1230 nm was also measured by cut-back (Methods)
alpha0_1230.applies_to: saturable small-signal absorption at the pump wavelength

alpha0_1310.fit: Eq. (1) of the source fitted to the transmission of a 30 m sample versus launched power at 1310 nm (Fig. 2)
alpha0_1310.applies_to: saturable small-signal absorption at the signal wavelength

Psat_1230.fit: as alpha0_1230; saturation power of the source's transverse-resolved Eq. (1), not a Giles saturation parameter

L.applies_to: length of the active fiber in all amplifier configurations

coil_radius.applies_to: spool radius of the active fiber

splice_loss.applies_to: splice loss of the active fiber

source.locator: 'A gain value of 20 dB is achieved at the launched pump power of 250 mW'; abstract: commercial 1230 nm diode with 250 mW

P_p_launched.applies_to: launched pump power of the 20 dB operating point; the optical module uses a 300 mW diode

pump_directions.value: forward, backward, bidirectional (one source split by a 50/50 fused coupler)

source.locator: Methods: -25 dBm at each wavelength, 4 nm spectral width, step about 4 nm

P_probe.applies_to: probe of the gain and NF spectra

lambda_s_test.applies_to: signal wavelength of the two-level consistency test (the wavelength of the fitted card values; the published gain anchors refer to about 1.32 um)

Pp_grid_test.applies_to: launched pump powers at which the consistency test evaluates the gain and the gain coefficient G/P_p

source.locator: Results (Fig. 4); abstract: 20 dB 'achieved for signal powers between -40 and -10 dBm'

G_250mW.applies_to: gain at 250 mW launched pump; the text names neither the pumping direction nor the wavelength for this value

gain_coefficient.applies_to: maximum gain coefficient, backward pumping, signal near 1.32 um

source.locator: 'peak gain values in the tested BDFAs are greater than 25 dB at a wavelength of 1320 nm with a noise figure of 5-6 dB'

G_peak.applies_to: peak gain at 1320 nm; pump power and direction not stated with this value

BW_3dB.applies_to: maximum 3-dB width of the gain spectrum

NF.unit: [NF_min dB, NF_max dB, lambda_lo nm, lambda_hi nm]
NF.applies_to: wavelength ranges with NF of 5-6 dB for each pumping direction (-25 dBm probe)

source.locator: Fig. 5 and text, gain at 1310 nm versus signal power

Psat_in.applies_to: input saturation power for the different pumping schemes (definition as in the source)

source.locator: 'ranges from +(7-8) to +(14-16) dBm with the BDFA design'

Psat_out.applies_to: output saturation power range over the configurations

source.locator: 'greater than +20 dBm (100 mW) for all the BDFA configurations'

not_reported: density of bismuth active centers (stated only as one to two orders of magnitude below the total Bi content)
absorption and emission cross sections; metastable lifetime
numerical alpha(lambda) and g*(lambda) spectra (absorption and gain spectra only as figures)
insertion losses of isolators and pump couplers (reference plane of gain and NF)

consistency_tests.method: tables_bands.bdfa_two_level_check(): single-center two-level Giles model with explicit unsaturable loss, backward pump at 1230 nm, -25 dBm signal at 1310 nm, 140 m, g*(1230 nm) = 0 assumed; shooting on the residual pump

tested_pair.origin: two-parameter calibration of the analysis phase (A_beyond_c_band.md, item R1-9-BDFA) to the two published anchors 20 dB at 250 mW and 0.18 dB/mW; recorded here only to test it

consistency_tests.card_implied_two_level: xi = P_sat(1230) alpha0(1230) / (h nu_p) = 5.77e14 1/(m s); alpha0(1310) + g*(1310) = h nu_s xi / P_sat(1310) gives g*(1310) = 0.35 dB/m; full-inversion bound (g* - alpha_BG) L = 44.9 dB; predicted G(250 mW) = 41.1 dB and max G/P_p = 0.73 dB/mW (at 40 mW), against 20 dB and 0.18 dB/mW measured
consistency_tests.sensitivity: +30 % / -30 % on P_sat(1310) moves g*(1310) to 0.18 / 0.68 dB/m, so the fitted saturation powers cannot fix g*
consistency_tests.two_anchor_calibration: a pair (xi = 9.5e14 1/(m s), g* = 0.185 dB/m) chosen in the analysis phase to reproduce the two anchors (20 dB at 250 mW, 0.18 dB/mW) has zero degrees of freedom; it implies P_sat(1310) = 1.05 mW (2.1 x the fitted 0.5 mW) and P_sat(1230) = 1.48 mW (1.6 x 0.9 mW), and caps the gain at (g* - alpha_BG) L = 21.7 dB, below the measured peak of > 25 dB. It is therefore not a validation and is not used
consistency_tests.conclusion: no single-center two-level parameter set reproduces both the transmission-saturation fit and the amplifier data of this fiber; the card is kept as reference data
